description: mu-Toni layer-preset hot-swap: a layer preset with both oscillator levels at minimum is staged onto layer 0 (the audible factory layer) at 0.5 s. It must wait for the 2.0 s bar line, then silence the layer.

assertions.name: still_playing_before_bar_line
assertions.comment: the swap requested at 0.5 s did NOT apply at once — it waits for the bar line

assertions.name: silent_after_bar_line
assertions.comment: after the bar-line commit (2.0 s at 120 BPM) the swapped-in state is silent
